title: Peer-state and partial-read admission refresh
mode: primary-source open-source peer research plus a local fast test-harness safety slice
scope: Reconcile current LibreDWG and ACadSharp issue reports with existing local plan owners
Verify the ezdxf binary proxy-graphic fix, merge status, tag identity, and package metadata
Prevent partial DXF entity callbacks followed by a later OBJECTS error from counting as whole-file interop success
Keep optional peer, native, modeler-semantic, fixture, and support gates separate

method.kind: Primary project issue/PR/release pages and local source/test review

sources.use: Release-specific report of R2013+ AcDs/SAB modeler loss; retained as a peer negative-control lead, not a local defect or current-master verdict.
Peer report groups zero-valued HATCH coordinates, unusual attribute tags, and embedded-MTEXT handling; existing local owners already separate those routes.
Peer report of CMC palette-index/RGB handling; existing local method/index checks remain the relevant owner.
Current issue index for open modeler-writer, SPLINE, MTEXT whole-file, plot-DPI/layout, LEADER, nested-block, and legacy-input reports. These reports remain version/route bound.
Legacy report requests recovery for TABLE tokens outside a standard TABLES section; no local sample was obtained, so it is only a noncanonical-input candidate.
Original ASCII/Binary proxy-graphic writer failure report; issue closed after merged fix.
Merged fix c87c87e, merged to master on 2026-10-02; PR reports raw binary chunks passed through the tag-writer protocol and focused peer-local tests.
The v1.4.5 tag page identifies commit 84ae319 and tag date 2026-10-16. This review did not verify ancestry to c87c87e.
PyPI lists the 1.4.5 source archive SHA-256 a6c3bbc1a65ce764d97c5beafe6ae693d8ed14c6cdae366b50e1974a79d4a00a; the archive was not downloaded or inspected.

localSourceReview.change: readDxfModelerCarrierSnapshots records whole-file import completion while retaining partial modeler snapshots for diagnostics; the ASCII/Binary comparison refuses a positive result unless both files fully parse.

findings.existingGateRefined: S2.2.5b whole-file Binary-DXF admission and fail-closed comparison diagnostics

peerRouteAssessment.LibreDWG: #1411/#1410/#1415 remain peer-specific reports and map to existing AcDs, HATCH/text grammar, and CMC owners.
peerRouteAssessment.ACadSharp: #1195/#1299/#1297/#1184/#1180 remain version-bound failure leads mapped to existing modeler, SPLINE, whole-file/native, LAYOUT, and LEADER owners; #1128 is an optional noncanonical-input compatibility candidate only.
peerRouteAssessment.ezdxf: #1412 was fixed by merged #1418 at c87c87e. Tag v1.4.5 points to 84ae319 and PyPI sdist hash is recorded, but source archive correspondence is unresolved.
peerRouteAssessment.binaryDxfCandidate: NOT_QUALIFIED; local scratch parser previously captured ENTITIES then failed at OBJECTS, and the three-byte carrier tail difference remains unexplained.

implementationReadyChecks: Keep partial parser output visible only as diagnostic evidence; whole-file success requires the importer to complete without a later OBJECTS-stage failure.
Do not normalize or waive the current three-byte SAT-carrier mismatch without an independently accepted same-file route and producer-backed explanation.
Keep the generated ASCII/Binary chunk-boundary matrix as the fast local check; do not add a full-suite or native run to this slice.
If no already-installed independent parser accepts a local full-file Binary-DXF control, record NOT_QUALIFIED once and immediately self-unblock to the next dependency-ready implementation item.
Keep noncanonical TABLE-section recovery out of standard parser behavior unless explicit compatibility policy and a safe generated repro are established.

validation.scratchBinaryComparison: expected nonzero partial/failure result; not counted as a passing test or interop positive
validation.commitBlocker: Shared worktree contains extensive user-owned changes; no staging or commit performed.

limitations: No peer repository was cloned or built, and no peer executable or native CAD/kernel was run.
The ezdxf 1.4.5 source archive was not downloaded or inspected; tag/package inclusion of c87c87e remains unverified.
Issue reports and project release declarations are not normative format rules and do not establish libdxfrw behavior.
No report reviewed here qualifies ACIS B-rep semantics, AcDs key/owner closure, or native Linux/Windows consumers.
